persona: Eleanor (78yo, Cardiology Patient, low tech literacy)

tasks.name: Configure Caregiver Proxy Access
tasks.verbatim: Where do I uncheck the therapy records? I don't want my sister reading my depression history.

tasks.name: Diagnose Appointment Not-Ready Flag
tasks.verbatim: It says fasting required, but which doctor wrote that? My cardiologist or the surgeon?

tasks.name: Reconcile Conflicting Preparation Advice
tasks.verbatim: The text message said stop blood thinners 3 days before, but the app says 5 days. Who do I believe?

critical_incidents.heuristic: Accessibility / WCAG 2.2 AA Contrast
critical_incidents.observation: Assistive technology (200% Zoom) failed to identify the secondary action button due to 2.8:1 contrast ratio against gray card background.
